text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, December 28, 2018 Posted by admin on December 28th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open UP +112 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +260.37 (+1.14%) at 23,138.82.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -6.39%.
There were 28 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by 3M (MMM) +2.38%, IBM (IBM) +2.15%, Procter & Gamble (PG) +2.14% and DowDuPont (DWDP) +2.11%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were Apple (AAPL) -0.65% and United Technologies (UTX) -0.24%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down eight-tenths of a cent at $2.289 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to release earnings in the near term.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
IBM (IBM)
IBM (IBM) is down -25.84% year-to-date.
